say:2:1010303001:0.text: Can you youngsters be a little more low-key?
say:2:1010303001:0.source_cn: 年轻人……你们几个，能稍微低调点吗？

say:3:1010303002:0.text: I remember your faces. You were there when we were putting out the fires. You're back here to investigate what happened, right?
say:3:1010303002:0.source_cn: 我记得你们这几张面孔，救援火灾时，你们也在。你们又来调...

say:5:1010303003:0.text: I may be old and forgetful, but I assure you that the people you're describing don't live in Northville.
say:5:1010303003:0.source_cn: 虽然我老了，健忘，但我敢确定，你们描述的那些人并不住在...

say:6:1010303004:0.text:
Come to think of it. I think Hank saw some outsiders around in the wheat fields that evening.
But I'm not sure if those are the people you're looking for.
say:6:1010303004:0.source_cn: 不过，那天傍晚，汉克看到了外人在麦田里走动。\n不知道...

say:8:1010303005:0.text: Hank is the only fisherman around these parts. He's got no interest in farming, so he spends his days fishing.
say:8:1010303005:0.source_cn: 汉克是我们这里唯一的渔夫，他不喜欢种地，只喜欢钓鱼。

say:9:1010303006:0.text: If you want to talk to him, keep heading north along the river, and you'll find him up at the lake.
say:9:1010303006:0.source_cn: 你要是想找他聊聊，就继续往北走走，静河上游有一片湖泊。
say:9:1010303006:0.male: If you want to talk to him, keep heading north along the river, and you'll find him up at the lake.
say:9:1010303006:0.female: If you want to talk to him, keep heading north along the river, and you'll find him up at the lake.

say:10:1010303007:0.text: Poor Hank's been really worried lately ever since this cold weather froze the lake over...
say:10:1010303007:0.source_cn: 天气越来越冷，那片湖都结了冰，汉克每天都在发愁……

say:11:1010303008:0.text: I don't know the details. You'll have to ask Hank.
say:11:1010303008:0.source_cn: 详细的我也不知道，你得去问问汉克。
